title: Retry policy maintenance with edge cases
final_response:
Done. Patched `should_retry` in `retry_policy.py` (same signature, docstring preserved):

```python
return method.upper() in ("GET", "HEAD") and status in (429, 503) and attempt < 3
```

- **Method**: case-insensitive GET/HEAD only — `POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE` rejected.
- **Status**: exactly 429 or 503 — other 5xx (500, 502, 504) and non-error codes rejected (old code retried any 5xx).
- **Attempts**: `attempt < 3` — retries stop at attempt 3; attempt 0 or 1 still allowed per the "starts at 1" contract edge.

Verified: `python3 test_visible.py` → "visible tests PASS", plus 18 edge-case checks (case variations, boundary attempts 0/1/2/3/99, off-contract statuses/methods) all pass.
